title: Assistant agentic extensibility: subagents, skills, commands, hooks

criteria.statement: Each loader parses claude-code-convention frontmatter and rejects malformed frontmatter, missing required fields, unsupported hook events/handler types, and duplicate names with a hard error.
The bahia_assistant_delegate_subagent internal tool runs a bounded child loop and returns the child result to the parent model as a synchronous succeeded observation.
A subagent tool call is restricted to its allowed-tool subset; a call outside the subset is denied and never executed (tool-restriction intersection).
PreToolUse hooks gate tool execution: a deny yields a denied observation without executing the tool, and an ask defers the call for operator approval; hooks can never upgrade a base deny to an allow.
A Stop hook that returns block prevents loop completion and forces the model to continue, then completes once the block clears.

Skills inject only names/descriptions at turn start; the read-only bahia_assistant_skill_load tool returns a skill body and confines supporting-file reads to the skill root (traversal/absolute paths rejected).
A leading slash-command is expanded into the initial user message (with $ARGUMENTS/$N substitution) before the loop runs, and command allowed-tools scope the exposed schema list.
Assistant config exposes subagents/skills/commands/hooks path blocks that reject parent traversal and require a non-empty path list when enabled; the build (go build ./...) passes.
